question:
Name the ID of the patient who is born on the April 1st, 1982. Is his/her alkaliphophatase (ALP) within normal range?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: alkaliphophatase (ALP) within normal range refers to ALP < 300

prediction.sql:
SELECT p.XCL_058,
       CASE WHEN MAX(l.XCL_019) < 300 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS within_normal_range
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON p.XCL_058 = l.XCL_014
WHERE p.XCL_060 = '1982-04-01'
GROUP BY p.XCL_058
